body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Headline abstention promise contradicts the status table (landscape high; 1/2). Agreed: README:43-45 vs README:370 ("Do not rely on ranking or abstention"); the confirming verifier also showed a nonsense task returns READY with 20 results. The refuting verifier reads the 7/36 as must-exclude precision, not abstention, and the bullet as a design contract. Settles it: an owner edit scoping the bullet, or an abstention-precision metric on an external held-out corpus admitted as a 1.0 release metric.
title: panel D14: Headline abstention promise contradicts the status table
